exposure.needed: which live service connections use Direct-Server-Return and were established while the cluster ran a Cilium version prior to v1.13.3

consequence.statement: Service connections that use Direct-Server-Return and were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted during the upgrade to 1.16.0 and need to be re-established.
consequence.remediation: Identify service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established before Cilium v1.13.3 and re-establish them (have the clients reconnect) as part of the upgrade.

assertion.statement: Service connections that use Direct-Server-Return and were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted by the upgrade to Cilium 1.16.0 and need to be re-established.
